title: Microwave-Polyol Synthesis of Sub-10-nm PbS Nanocrystals for Metal Oxide/Nanocrystal Heterojunction Photodetectors

source_inventory.title: Microwave-Polyol Synthesis of Sub-10-nm PbS Nanocrystals for Metal Oxide/Nanocrystal Heterojunction Photodetectors
source_inventory.scope: The author and independent auditor each read all ten main and eleven SI pages as text and original-page images. Microwave PbS route, intermediate aggregates, power alternatives, ZnO/IZO preparation, device coating variants, characterization specimens, hot-injection comparison and source conflicts are scoped separately. Cited external full recipes, introductory literature-only background values and unprinted curve values are excluded.
source_conflicts: Figure3 lower schematic labels After1 minute(endfirstMWstep), while upper image and Methods state2 minutes. The recipe remains the explicitly reported400 W / 2 min; source figure unchanged.
General oxide deposition here states5000 rpm. Device-specific ZnO coating on mainp6 states3000 rpm / 1 min and intermediate300 C / 15 min; kept separate.
Mainp3 calls the pattern hexagonal zinc blend; S3 states hexagonalP63mc. Literal terminology conflict retained without a cubic assignment.
Mainp4 granular aggregate inset description citesFigure2b even though2b is finalNCfilm; retain distinct panel contexts and source wording.
General oxide film recipe mainp3 uses5000 rpm, while this explicit device method uses3000 rpm.
Bare NC growth avoids long-ligand exchange, but actual devices explicitly receive EDT treatment.

Figure6d labels approximate current intervals ~650x10^-6A(MW) and ~1x10^-6A(hot injection) at different arrow positions. Prose reports ~40times response. Preserve these differently scoped claims without computing a replacement ratio.
Fig4caption labels panels inconsistently; actualpanelB andmainp6 showphototransistor,actualCbanddiagram.
Fig6caption/maintext refer to6aEQE and6bresponsivity, while actual axes identify6aResponsivity and6bEQE. Display followsactual axeswiththisconflictretained.
Text states2 min repetition,whileFig5cshowsmultiplecycleswithinroughly40s. Do notreplacewitha derivedperiod.
Caption assigns7crise/7dfall, but actualc falling trace3.24 s andd risingtrace2.24 s; text~3.2 s decay/~2.2 s rise.
166 mHz text and time-patterninFig7b retained without inferred correctedfrequency.
Source Fig3 first-step labels1min versus2min;Fig4caption versus actual panels inconsistent. Source illustrations preserved as reported, not a recovered physical geometry.
limitations: No inferred physical batch identity among source-associated samples.
No raw curve digitization, measured atomic coordinates or training eligibility.
Main source prints copyright2018AmericanChemicalSociety; unchanged attributed crops, reuse permission unverified.
